description_for_human: Services, published prices and case studies from Top-Rated Team, a grounded question, and a room address for the person you are talking to.
description_for_model: Use list_services to explain the offers and who invoices each one. Use list_prices to quote the published price rows verbatim — never invent a figure or a range. Use list_cases for the published case studies. Use ask_question only with a service that has a firstAgentId; it goes through the same spend ceiling as the site's ask panel. Rooms are not opened here: send people to https://top-rated.team/rooms for Top-Rated Team's rooms and to https://app.adgrant.ai/rooms.html for AdGrant.AI's. Do not claim a coming door's panel is open. Do not invent a price for a partner service.
